name: Prismatic Glacier Cathedral
description: A cathedral carved entirely from a massive glacier, its ice facets acting as prisms that split aurora light.
prompt: Grand cathedral interior carved from a single colossal glacier. Walls, columns, and vaulted ceiling are faceted ice prisms. The aurora borealis shines through, splitting into brilliant spectra that dance across the icy floor. Silhouettes of visitors in awe. Ultra‑realistic, cold color palette with vivid spectral highlights, 8K.
caption: Ice that sings with the northern lights ❄️🌈 #GlacierCathedral
